sanskrit: agne gobhir na ā gahi- -indo rayyā sacasva naḥ | indro dhartā gṛheṣu naḥ ||
english: O Agni, come to us with cattle; O Indu, be joined to us with wealth — Indra is the sustainer in our homes.

sanskrit: savitā yaḥ sahasriyaḥ sa no gṛheṣu raṇyatu | ā puṣṭam etv ā vasu ||
english: May Savitā, he who is thousandfold, rejoice in our homes — let abundance come, let riches come.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭā yo vṛṣabho yuvā sa no gṛheṣu rāraṇat | sahasreṇa śatena ca ||
english: May Tvaṣṭā, that young bull, exult in our homes — with a thousand and with a hundred.

sanskrit: dhātā dadhātu no rayim īśāno jagatas patiḥ | sa naḥ pūrṇena yacchatu ||
english: May Dhātā, the lord, the master of the universe, bestow wealth upon us — may he grant it to us in full measure.

sanskrit: mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā mamobhendrābṛhaspatī | mama tvaṣṭā ca pūṣā ca mamaiva savitā vaśe ||
english: Both Mitra and Varuṇa are under my sway; both Indra and Bṛhaspati are under my sway; Tvaṣṭā and Pūṣan, and Savitā himself — all are in my power.

sanskrit: mama viṣṇuś ca somaś ca mamaiva maruto bhuvan | sarasvāṃś ca bhagaś ca viśve devā vaśe mama ||
english: Viṣṇu and Soma are mine; the Maruts too have become mine; Sarasvan and Bhaga, and all the gods are under my sway.

sanskrit: mamobhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ svar mama | mamemāḥ sarvā oṣadhīr āpaḥ sarvā vaśe mama ||
english: Both heaven and earth are mine; the atmosphere and the sun are mine; all these herbs are mine, all waters are under my sway.

sanskrit: mama gāvo mamāśvā mamājāś cāvayaś ca | mamaiva puruṣā bhuvan mamedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad ejat prāṇad vaśe mama ||
english: The cattle are mine, the horses are mine, the goats and the sheep are mine; men too have become mine — all this that has a self, that stirs and breathes, is under my sway.

sanskrit: agne 'bhyāvartinn abhi na ā vavṛtsva | āyuṣā varcasā sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena ||
english: O Agni Abhyāvartin, turn back to us — with long life, with vital radiance, with gain, with wisdom, with offspring, with wealth.

sanskrit: agne jātavedaḥ śataṃ te santv āvṛtaḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ | adhā puṣṭasyeśānaḥ punar no rayim ā kṛdhi ||
english: O Agni Jātavedas, may your turnings be a hundred, your approachings a thousand — then, as lord of abundance, bestow wealth upon us once more.

sanskrit: saha rayyā ni vartasva- -agne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvatas pari ||
english: Turn back together with wealth, O Agni; swell with a stream nourishing all — from every direction, encompassing all.

sanskrit: punar ūrjā vavṛtsva punar agne viśāyuṣā | punar naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Turn back again with vital strength; O Agni, turn back with the full span of life — protect us once more from distress.
